question: For instances on host “blaze8-12” (and not deleted, in availability zone “flare3”), group by the system metadata key and show: the number of completed migrations on “blaze8-12”, the average of the per-key instance-memory window average (2 preceding to 2 following rows), and the maximum “next 2 migrations” max-memory window value from the completed-migration records. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    i.memory_mb,
    ism.`key` AS metadata_key
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND i.deleted = 0
    AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
),
mem_win AS (
  SELECT 
    metadata_key,
    AVG(memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key ORDER BY memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS mem_window_avg
  FROM base
),
mig AS (
  SELECT 
    b.metadata_key,
    m.id AS migration_id,
    m.memory_total
  FROM base b
  JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = b.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status = 'completed'
),
next2 AS (
  SELECT 
    metadata_key,
    MAX(memory_total) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key ORDER BY migration_id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS next2_max_mem
  FROM mig
)
SELECT 
  b.metadata_key,
  COUNT(mig.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count,
  AVG(mw.mem_window_avg) AS avg_mem_window_avg,
  MAX(n2.next2_max_mem) AS max_next2_max_mem
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN mem_win mw ON mw.metadata_key = b.metadata_key
LEFT JOIN mig ON mig.metadata_key = b.metadata_key
LEFT JOIN next2 n2 ON n2.metadata_key = b.metadata_key
GROUP BY b.metadata_key

  JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND i.deleted = 0
    AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
),
mem_win AS (
  SELECT 
    metadata_key,
    AVG(memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key ORDER BY memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS mem_window_avg
  FROM base
),
mig AS (
  SELECT 
    b.metadata_key,
    m.id AS migration_id,
    m.memory_total
  FROM base b
  JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = b.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status = 'completed'
),
next2 AS (
  SELECT 
    metadata_key,
    MAX(memory_total) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key ORDER BY migration_id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS next2_max_mem
  FROM mig
)
SELECT 
  b.metadata_key,
  COUNT(mig.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count,
  AVG(mw.mem_window_avg) AS avg_mem_window_avg,
  MAX(n2.next2_max_mem) AS max_next2_max_mem
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN mem_win mw ON mw.metadata_key = b.metadata_key
LEFT JOIN mig ON mig.metadata_key = b.metadata_key
LEFT JOIN next2 n2 ON n2.metadata_key = b.metadata_key
GROUP BY b.metadata_key
